summary: ansible_loop_var (2.8+) gives the name used in loop_control.loop_var, letting role authors read the current item with lookup('vars', ansible_loop_var).
questions: How can a role get the current loop item if the loop_var name varies?

answer_card.title: Accessing the loop_var name
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible_loop_var` holds the name set in `loop_control.loop_var`. In a role, get the current item without dictating the name:

```yaml
"{{ lookup('vars', ansible_loop_var) }}"
```
